name: Context Receipt Store
description: Context receipt store with a closed feedback loop: gateway receipts, outcomes (thumbs/edits/escalations), learned item priors, and an optional Dagster sensor that reports aggregated usage, flags stale reads and can request rebuilds.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key for the ContextReceiptStore.

database_path.label: Database Path
database_path.description: SQLite file path for local or single-host prototypes. Use a shared receipt service/database for multi-host production writes.

usage_sensor_enabled.label: Usage Sensor
usage_sensor_enabled.description: Add a sensor that tails receipts, reports aggregated usage as AssetObservations on source assets, refreshes learned item priors, and can request rebuilds.

rebuild_asset_keys.label: Rebuildable Asset Keys
rebuild_asset_keys.description: Asset keys the sensor may re-materialize when stale reads pile up. Empty means observe only, never trigger runs.

stale_reads_threshold.label: Stale Reads Threshold
stale_reads_threshold.description: Receipt items served from an out-of-date data version before a rebuild is requested.

score_prior_strength.label: Prior Strength
score_prior_strength.description: Shrinkage for item quality priors: higher needs more outcome evidence to move a prior.

check_asset_keys.label: Check Asset Keys
check_asset_keys.description: Asset keys to attach context-health asset checks to (staleness, outcome quality, verified share). The assets must be defined in the same code location.

max_stale_share.label: Max Stale Share
max_stale_share.description: Fail context_staleness above this share of stale reads.

min_mean_outcome.label: Min Mean Outcome
min_mean_outcome.description: Warn context_outcome_quality below this mean outcome.

min_checked_receipts.label: Min Outcomes To Judge
min_checked_receipts.description: Outcomes needed before the quality check judges.

implicit_signals_enabled.label: Implicit Signals
implicit_signals_enabled.description: Derive weak implicit outcomes from session behaviour: a caller re-asking within reformulation_window_seconds with a different query marks the earlier receipt 'reformulated' (-0.2). A heuristic that needs mcp_session_id and query_hash on receipts; off by default.

reformulation_window_seconds.label: Reformulation Window (s)
reformulation_window_seconds.description: Max gap between two retrievals to count as a reformulation.

max_ungrounded_rate.label: Max Ungrounded Rate
max_ungrounded_rate.description: Warn context_grounding above this share of ungrounded claims (reported by a verifier in evidence details).

enforce_retention.label: Enforce Retention
enforce_retention.description: Have the usage sensor delete receipts past the retention_days declared in the policies of the assets they used (the shortest applicable retention wins). Reads policies from every context asset in the code location. This is the only deletion the receipt store performs.

backend.label: Backend
backend.description: Where receipts live: 'sqlite' (a local file) or 'bigquery' (tables in a BigQuery dataset, shared across hosts, queryable from SQL-mode pipelines).

bigquery_dataset.label: Bigquery Dataset
bigquery_dataset.description: backend: bigquery -- 'project.dataset' holding the receipt tables (created on first use if missing). The same dataset a SQL-mode context_engineering_pipeline `receipts: {dataset: ...}` reads.

bigquery_table_prefix.label: Bigquery Table Prefix
bigquery_table_prefix.description: backend: bigquery -- prefix for the five receipt table names (e.g. 'prod_'), to keep several environments in one dataset.

bigquery_location.label: Bigquery Location
bigquery_location.description: backend: bigquery -- BigQuery location, e.g. 'US' or 'EU'.

gcp_credentials_env_var.label: Gcp Credentials Env Var
gcp_credentials_env_var.description: backend: bigquery -- env var holding the service-account JSON (base64-encoded, as dagster-gcp expects). Omit to use Application Default Credentials.

async_writes.label: Async Writes
async_writes.description: backend: bigquery -- queue writes on a background thread (a load job takes seconds, so an agent should not wait on it). Reads see only finished writes; call flush() for read-your-writes. Not crash-safe.
